note: SGSM3 variants are linked to autosomal recessive intellectual developmental disorder 84 (characterized by developmental delay), making preservation vs loss of expressive speech an open, testable clinical question.

evidence.text: Autosomal recessive intellectual developmental disorder-84 is associated with developmental delay, short stature, and dysmorphic facial features.
